sources.entry: Replit - An AI-enhanced online coding environment with Ghostwriter, an AI-powered coding assistant for real-time code suggestions, debugging, and completion. Supports multi-language development in an interactive web-based IDE.

summary.name: Replit
summary.one_liner: Replit is an AI app and website builder where you describe what you want and it generates, hosts and publishes a working app or site.
use_cases: build a web app from a text description
add AI or Stripe integrations to an app
collaborate on a team app with enterprise controls
summary.what_it_does: Replit lets users describe an app or website in plain language, and its chat and Agent features write and evolve the code. The platform bundles built-in authentication, database, hosting and monitoring so projects can be published without separate setup. It offers over 100 integrations, including OpenAI, Stripe and Google Workspace. An Infinite Canvas lets users adjust designs visually and apply them to the app. Enterprise plans add SSO/SAML, SOC 2 and admin controls.
notable: Describe-to-publish workflow with Replit Agent and chat
Built-in auth, database, hosting and monitoring
Enterprise security: SSO/SAML, SOC 2, single-tenant options
caveats: Free mode has usage limits (up to 30 hours of chat and 60 projects)
Paid tiers (Core, Pro, Max) unlock more model usage and collaborators; enterprise pricing is custom
